verdict.rationale: The docs show a GGUF model example using Q8_0 quantization (localai-docs-21), implying support for quantized models, but there is no explicit documentation of a range of integer quantization levels (e.g., 4-bit, 5-bit, or lower-bit formats) or explanation of memory savings. missing for 10: explicit docs on multiple quantization levels (2-bit/4-bit/5-bit/8-bit), memory footprint comparisons, guidance on choosing quantization for power users.
